Learn More Benefits and Services Worldwide capabilities Global claims network supporting our marine insurance clients Underwriting and claims leadership expertise Coverage Hull Our marine hull insurance covers all sizes of vessel from the largest tankers and containerships to small craft and yachts. We protect ocean-going vessels worldwide against risks such as physical damage and collision liability. Hull and War We offer marine hull war insurance to protect against the risk of piracy and terrorism, as well as war physical damage to vessels. In conjunction with our Crisis Management & Special Risks team, we also offer kidnap and ransom insurance for individual vessels and fleets on an annual or single voyage basis. Coverage includes a full crisis response service if the policy is triggered.
